correctness.rationale: All 9841 projective forms were checked by two structurally different geometric smoothness methods, yielding 5184 smooth forms. Both 3594672-pair/6 counting and independent enumeration of 8069620 uniquely normalized 2-planes yield 599112 pencils and identical four stratum counts. A direct four-chart Jacobian check and rational point evaluation confirm an explicit 3-basepoint witness. Sum-of-member point incidence plus Hasse bounds gives b<=4; exhaustive census and joint point counts exclude 4. Exact finite proof with complete code, no sampling.

value.rationale: The natural geometry is the incidence of common F3-rational base points for elliptic biquadratic pencils whose entire rational pencil lies in the smooth locus. The 0–3 complete distribution measures genuinely simultaneous four-curve compatibility, a datum not determined by one-curve counts. The extremal value three is one below Hasse-incidence permission and is realized by 23040 pencils; useful as an exact benchmark for genus-one linear systems over small finite fields.
